limitations: The record of their childhood emotional experience was restricted to the 6~12 year old memories.
Because of the location of the survey site, it may not possible to generalize the results to other areas of cities in both countries.
The results cannot be generalized to other age groups, or other type of professionals.

Any conclusion concerning the measurement of childhood emotional experience and perception of personalization must be limited to the responses of students who live in the Busan Metropolitan area, Korea or College Station, Texas, in America.
It is possible that those who did not reply to the survey were less supportive of the study concepts.
Conclusions regarding students' attitude and their evaluations will have to be limited to the assessable independent variables provided by the responses to the survey questionnaires.
